newsitem.title: UK: Fitch rates Utilities Co-op $125 mln issue A plus.
newsitem.headline: Fitch rates Utilities Co-op $125 mln issue A plus.

text.p: Fitch Investors Service said on Monday it had assigned an A plus rating to the $125 million 8.00 percent quarterly income capital securities of National Rural Utilities Cooperative Finance Corp.

"Additionally, the $1.0 billion of collateral trust bonds are affirmed at AA, the roughly $2.8 billion of outstanding medium-term notes, leveraged lease debt and long-term, tax-exempt guarantees affirmed at AA minus and the approximately $4.9 billion of commercial paper and short-term, tax-exempt guarantees at F1 plus," Fitch said.

It said the rating reflected CFC's sound financial position, strong asset quality and sufficient reserves to adequately cover potential losses, as well as CFC's position as the primary lender to more than 1,000 rural electric cooperatives and its conservative credit guidelines.

"The biggest credit risk is CFC's exposure to the troubled Deseret Generation & Transmission Cooperative. Also, the rate disadvantage of many cooperatives becomes more of a credit issue as the electric industry transitions to a competitive environment," Fitch said.
"The A plus rating also takes into account the subordination of the capital securities to other indebtedness of CFC," Fitch said.
